title: 第3072章 横渡紫金长生海踏入不朽长生界第3071章 打入敌人内部演技
slug: 废武魂我逆天进化震惊世界
content_zh:
血影仙化作的邪藤古祖顺利潜入黑暗阵营。
风祖等人惊呆了。
心脏砰砰乱跳，没想到这血魔教主演技如此精湛，竟然敢在上百个黑暗古祖眼皮子底下搞猫腻。
神了！
而且种种不合理的迹象，通过他给自己树立的急于突破，走火入魔精神错乱的形象都给规避过去了，敌人愣是一点异样都没察觉。
甚至此时都不敢招惹这一位“邪藤古祖”，深怕自己也成为对方掌中蹂躏的圆珠的一员。
血影仙分身细细打量着天哑古祖率领一众黑暗古祖布置下的百祖夜行大阵，暗自惊叹。
此阵气象万千，诡异非凡，集结了上百尊黑暗古祖的力量，一旦三日后爆发，必定是石破天惊。
这不朽长生界的护界大阵虽然强横，但未必挡得住如此凶猛的进攻。
眼下就看本体能不能顺利的潜伏到不朽长生大界了。
“唰！”
此时的洛凡尘本尊携带着功德无上之躯，肉身和灵魂无上之躯，以及祭灵无上之躯来到了不朽长生界的大阵之外。
远距离看还好，近距离便感觉到了不朽长生大界最外围大阵紫金长生海的波澜壮阔了。
那紫金色的长生海洋波光粼粼，似乎每一滴海水都是一个微缩的小世界，若是在紫金长生海之中横渡，便仿佛肉身之上背负着一个个小世界，举步维艰。
而布置阵法的一尊尊强者则可以趁此时机发动进攻，对横渡海洋者进行绞杀。
一个可以肆无忌惮的施展攻击，另一个被海量大界之力压制，胜负自然不言而喻。
洛凡尘目光又向着内部看去，纵然是跨过了这紫金长生海，后面还有亘古不朽丰碑。
那一个个巨大不规则的不朽丰碑矗立在那里，隔绝着前方的去路，每一座不朽丰碑蕴藏的法则之力都截然不同，有的丰碑让人致幻，有的丰碑让人感受到一股恐怖的重力。
纵然有生灵可以侥幸扛住压力，从紫金长生海之中杀出，也要面临这第二重考验。
几乎所有的黑暗古祖都被阻拦在长生海和不朽丰碑之外，无奈之下才退到大后方进行布阵。

“哗啦，哗啦——”
在不朽丰碑之后还有不朽长生大界最恐怖的火焰，乾坤灭道极火，沾染大道之力就会猛烈灼烧。
遇到越强大的道则燃烧的越凶猛，一经燃烧，只要对方身上有大道存在，便永远不会熄灭。
三重奇伟的无双仙阵就在眼前，洛凡尘呲牙咧嘴。
这阵法有点生猛啊。
与这不朽长生界一比，简直就是姥姥不亲舅舅不爱。
他藏在匿因隐果无上仙阵之中寻找着应对之法。
强攻肯定是不行的。
上百个黑暗古祖都做不到的事情，他就更不可能了。
若是自报家门，说是前来驰援的大道共济会人员，先不说对方敢不敢打开防御仙阵，他只要开口的一瞬间，便会被上百个黑暗古祖团团围住，到时候就是生死难料了。
洛凡尘呲牙咧嘴。
布置仙阵倒是布置个弱一点的啊，他这进都不好进去。
他这辈子，被困在门外的时候不多。
有办法了！
洛凡尘眸光一亮。
匿因隐果无上仙阵发动，向着紫金长生海横渡。
content_en:
The evil vine ancestor transformed into the Blood Shadow Fairy successfully sneaked into the dark camp.
Feng Zu and others were shocked.
My heart was beating wildly. I didn't expect that the Blood Demon Cultist's leading role was so skilled that he dared to do tricks under the noses of hundreds of Dark Ancestors.
God!
Moreover, all kinds of irrational signs were avoided through the image he had established for himself of being eager to break through, being obsessed and insane, and the enemy did not notice anything strange at all.
Even at this time, he did not dare to provoke this "Ancient Ancestor of the Evil Vine", for fear that he would become one of the Yuanzhu ravaged in the palm of his hand.
The clone of Blood Shadow Immortal carefully looked at the Hundred Ancestor Night Walk Array set up by the Ancient Ancestor Tianmute led by a group of Dark Ancestors, and secretly marveled.
This formation is full of strange and extraordinary phenomena, gathering the power of hundreds of dark ancient ancestors. Once it breaks out in three days, it will definitely be earth-shattering.
Although the protective formation of the Immortal Realm is powerful, it may not be able to withstand such a ferocious attack.
Now it depends on whether the main body can successfully lurk into the realm of immortality.
"Uh-huh!"
At this time, Luo Fanchen himself carried the supreme body of merit, the supreme body of flesh and soul, and the supreme body of sacrificial spirits to the outside of the great formation of the immortal world.
It looked fine from a distance, but from a short distance, I could feel the majestic waves of the Purple-Gold Sea of ​​Immortality, the outermost formation of the Immortal Realm.
The purple-gold ocean of immortality is sparkling, as if every drop of sea water is a miniature world. If you cross the purple-gold ocean of immortality, it will be as if your body is carrying small worlds on its back, making it difficult to move.
The powerful person who arranged the formation can take this opportunity to launch an attack and strangle those who cross the ocean.
One can attack unscrupulously, while the other is suppressed by the power of the massive world. The outcome is self-evident.
Luo Fanchen looked inside again. Even though he had crossed the purple-gold sea of ​​immortality, there was an eternal monument behind him.
The huge and irregular immortal monuments stand there, blocking the way forward. The power of laws contained in each immortal monument is completely different. Some monuments make people hallucinate, and some monuments make people feel a terrifying gravity.
Even if there are creatures that can luckily withstand the pressure and fight their way out of the Purple Gold Sea of ​​Eternal Life, they will still have to face this second test.
Almost all the Dark Ancestors were blocked from the Sea of ​​Eternal Life and the Immortal Monument, and they had no choice but to retreat to the rear to set up formations.
"Whoa, whoa-"
Behind the immortal monument, there is the most terrifying flame in the world of immortality, the Qiankun Dao Extreme Fire, which will burn violently if it is contaminated by the power of the Dao.
The more powerful the Tao is, the more fierce it will burn. Once burned, as long as the Tao exists in the opponent, it will never be extinguished.
The three-level majestic unparalleled immortal formation was right in front of him, and Luo Fanchen bared his teeth.
This formation is a bit fierce.
Compared with this world of immortality, it is as if grandma is not close to her and uncle does not love her.
He hid in the Supreme Immortal Formation of Hidden Causes and Hidden Fruits, looking for a way to deal with it.
A forceful attack will definitely not work.
What hundreds of dark ancestors couldn't do, it was even more impossible for him.
If he announces his home address and says he is a member of the Grand Avenue Freemasonry who has come to the rescue, not to mention whether the other party dares to open the defensive immortal formation, the moment he opens his mouth, he will be surrounded by hundreds of dark ancestors, and his life or death will be uncertain.
Luo Fanchen bared his teeth.
The Immortal Formation is a weaker one, and it's hard for him to get in now.
In his life, he had rarely been trapped outside the door.
There is a way!
Luo Fanchen's eyes lit up.
The Supreme Immortal Formation of Hidden Causes and Hidden Fruits is activated and crosses towards the Purple Gold Sea of ​​Immortality.
